propositions: Configuration schema fields in _config_schema.py can be defined but never read, causing the knob to silently do nothing at runtime.
No automated check currently exists to detect zero-read-site schema fields, unlike the existing env-vars.md drift gate for environment variables.
An AST-level deterministic check must require each schema field to have at least one attribute-read site in the codebase outside schema/config plumbing modules.
Fields with legitimately indirect reads (getattr dispatch, client-only knobs) require an explicit '# read-via: <pointer>' comment marker; bare markers must be rejected.
The check must fire only on zero-reference fields (no false positives on refactored reads) and integrate into CI to prevent inert config from landing.
